cast.hair: a short beard and a backwards cap

shots.scene: Small hands squeeze the handlebar grips of a little bicycle, knuckles tight.
On a long park path a small girl sits on her bicycle while her tall father holds the seat from behind.
shots.setting: a long park path lined with trees

characters.action: holds the seat and bends low

poses: The tiny girl in the teal tee pushes one pedal down while the very tall man jogs beside her holding the seat.

shots.scene: At sunset practice the bicycle wobbles hard and the father runs alongside, both straining.
poses: The tiny girl in the teal tee sits straighter and pedals faster as the very tall man loosens his grip.

shots.scene: The father stops in front of the camera and lets go as his daughter rolls on ahead alone.

characters.action: stands still with open empty hands

shots.scene: From low on the path the girl rides past alone, head up, realizing nobody is holding on.

characters.action: rides alone with her head up

shots.scene: Next morning, seen from above, the girl rides circles around her father on the empty path.
shots.setting: the park path in the early morning

characters.action: stands in the middle sipping coffee

shots.scene: The father walks beside his daughter as she rides slowly down the long tree-lined path into the morning haze.
shots.setting: the long park path in morning haze

characters.action: walks beside with hands in pockets
